description: This is a test suite for the iscc_sdk audio processing module, including tests for metadata extraction, embedding, feature extraction, and thumbnail handling.

methods.name: test_audio_meta_extract
methods.description: Tests extraction of audio metadata from a file.

methods.name: test_audio_meta_extract_concurrent
methods.description: Tests concurrent reading and extraction of audio metadata.

methods.name: test_audio_meta_extract_all
methods.description: Tests extraction of metadata from all audio files provided by iss.audios().

methods.name: test_audio_meta_embed_mp3
methods.description: Tests embedding metadata into an MP3 file and verifying the embedded data.

methods.name: test_audio_meta_embed_wav
methods.description: Tests embedding metadata into a WAV file and verifying the embedded data.

methods.name: test_audio_extract_features
methods.description: Tests extraction of audio features, including fingerprint data.

methods.name: test_code_audio_mp3
methods.description: Tests generating a code (hash and ISCC) from an MP3 file.

methods.name: test_code_audio_wav
methods.description: Tests generating a code (hash and ISCC) from a WAV file.

methods.name: test_audio_thumbnail_none
methods.description: Verifies that no thumbnail is returned when none exists.

methods.name: test_audio_thumbnail_found
methods.description: Verifies that a thumbnail image is returned when available.

methods.name: test_audio_thumbnail_via_code_audio
methods.description: Tests thumbnail extraction via code_audio metadata.

methods.name: test_audio_embed_title
methods.description: Tests embedding a title into audio metadata.

methods.name: test_code_audio_metadata_meta_thumb_disabled
methods.description: Tests code_audio behavior when metadata and thumbnail creation are disabled.
